content.title: WARNER BROS. FOR YOUR CONSIDERATION
content.text: for your consideration CONVERSATIONS + CONTENT One Battle After Another Ensemble In Conversation Actors Leonardo DiCaprio, Teyana Taylor, Chase Infinti, Sean Penn, Regina Hall, and Benicio Del Toro sit down for a conversation about their work on the film NEXT UP One Battle After Another Ensemble In Conversation Actors Leonardo DiCaprio, Teyana Taylor, Chase Infinti, Sean Penn, Regina Hall, and Benicio Del Toro sit down for a conversation about their work on the film Leonardo DiCaprio is Bob Ferguson Academy Award Winner Leonardo DiCaprio is Bob Ferguson, a washed up revolutionary but most importantly, a father desperately fighting to save his daughter Chase Infiniti is Willa Ferguson In her feature film debut, Chase Infiniti stars as Willa, a fiercly independent young woman on a journey to discover who she is One Battle After Another in Conversation Writer/Director/Producer Paul Thomas Anderson sits down with casting director Cassandra Kulukundis and the ensemble cast Paul Thomas Anderson & Leonardo DiCaprio in Conversation Writer/Director/Producer Paul Thomas Anderson sits down with Actor Leonardo DiCaprio to discuss their collaboration on the film ShotDeck: Shot Talk - DP Michael Bauman & Producer Sara Murphy Longtime Paul Thomas Anderson collaborators Michael Bauman and Sara Murphy delve into their work on their latest epic One Battle After Another. From resurrecting the long-dormant VistaVision format, to navigating an ambitious three-year location-scouting journey, to working on set without last looks or monitors, the conversation uncovers the meticulous, often unconventional behind-the-scenes process that shaped the film’s sweeping vision Clubhouse Conversations — One Battle After Another Cinematographer Michael Bauman is joined by interviewer Eric Steelberg, ASC to discuss his work on Paul Thomas Anderson's latest epic, One Battle After Another Andy Jurgensen on Editing One Battle After Another Editor Andy Jurgensen dives into the complexities of developing the film's tone, pacing, and how he collaborated closely with Anderson on this ambitious project.
